hero.subtitle: A house with soul, ten minutes from Trikala

about.label: The House
about.heading: A house full of stories
about.text: A house with character in Raxa, ten minutes from Trikala. A stone fireplace, wooden ceilings, mosaic floors and antiques in every corner — plus a large fenced lawn where children and pets can run free.
about.text2: Three bedrooms, two bathrooms, up to six guests. And a family that welcomes you as one of their own — the thing our guests remember most.

0.title: Welcome
0.text: A pink house among the green — or in the snow, if you come in winter.

1.title: The wooden staircase
1.text: Leading up to the loft and the upstairs bedrooms.

2.title: The stone fireplace
2.text: The heart of the house on cold evenings.

3.title: The living room
3.text: Double height, a chandelier and leather sofas for the whole group.

4.title: Every room, a surprise
4.text: Antiques, colour and details you won’t find anywhere else.

meteora.title: Meteora
meteora.desc: 14th-century monasteries atop 400m rock pillars. UNESCO World Heritage Site with breathtaking views.

elati.title: Elati
elati.desc: The largest mountain village. Hiking, forests, snow, and traditional architecture await.

pertouli.title: Pertouli
pertouli.desc: A village in the clouds with a ski resort. Azure forests and outdoor activities for all.

palaiokarya.title: Palaiokarya Waterfalls
palaiokarya.desc: Spectacular waterfalls, a 1517 stone bridge, and a 200-year-old traditional watermill.

pricing.label: Pricing
